arguments.sql: SELECT t.id AS transaction_id, t.amount_usd_cents / 100.0 AS amount_usd FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 200000 ORDER BY t.id
arguments.explanation: Lists the id and dollar amount of every transaction over $2,000 made on a prepaid debit card.
assumptions: Over $2,000 means strictly greater than 200000 cents, so exactly $2,000.00 is excluded.
Amount is shown in dollars as amount_usd_cents / 100.0.
All transactions are included whether or not they have a fraud label.
Results are ordered by transaction id.
